# #151 - Investor stärker greppet om OMXS30

**Feed**: montrosepodden  
**Published**: 2026-11-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts cover a volatile week: the OMXS30 fell 2.37%, the Nasdaq 100 sold off, then bounced sharply when Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia after pressure from Trump. They criticise the Nvidia board's handling as 'sloppy' but think the comeback matters for long-term confidence in AI. They argue this is not a bear market, because there is no hard central-bank tightening, no falling earnings and no stretched tech valuations. They also discuss new Trump tariffs, a hot US inflation print ahead of the 9 December Fed meeting, oil prices and Anthropic's IPO, including its 85.5% inference margin and the open question of whether it has a moat.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Jensen Huang's return restores long-term confidence; DNB Teknologi has added the stock on low valuations; guidance was raised for next year.

#### Reasoning

Hosts say Jensen's comeback matters mostly for 2029-2030+ confidence, since near-term results, including raised guidance, are strong. A cited fund manager (DNB Teknologi) is scaling up Nvidia because of the low valuation. Tech trades below its 5- and 10-year average valuations, and the hosts reject the bear-market case. Viktor warns of a higher risk premium from depending on one person, governance problems and state intervention.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the risk premium from key-person dependence and government intervention rises
- if gross margin keeps falling from about 71-72%
- if AI capex demand weakens or earnings start to fall
- if the Fed hikes more aggressively than expected

> *"Men där hade de faktiskt nu börjat skala upp både Nvidia och minnesbolagen. Just för att värderingarna är så låga."*

---

### 🟢 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited fund manager (DNB Teknologi) is buying memory stocks; around P/E 6 even if earnings halve.

#### Reasoning

The view comes from a cited fund manager, not the hosts. Memory stocks are priced very low: even if next year's earnings halve, the P/E would be about 6, so further downside should be limited. Sentiment is at rock bottom after the sell-off.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory earnings collapse by more than half
- if AI hardware demand falls sharply

> *"Så det är ju så här att säg att på en SG Heinix eller Micron då att vinsten halveras, då är det P6."*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Grouped with SK Hynix as a cheap memory stock in the cited DNB Teknologi view.

#### Reasoning

The same cited valuation argument as SK Hynix: around P/E 6 even if earnings halve, with very low expectations priced in. The fund manager did not explicitly say they hold Micron.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory earnings collapse by more than half
- if AI hardware demand falls sharply

> *"Så det är ju så här att säg att på en SG Heinix eller Micron då att vinsten halveras, då är det P6."*

---

### 🟠 AVGO — Broadcom | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Picks-and-shovels play if AI models have no moat and capex spending never ends.

#### Reasoning

Host's conditional view: if no frontier-model company has a lasting moat and spending is an endless capex race, it is better to own the suppliers (Nvidia, Broadcom, TSMC) than the model developers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if model developers prove a durable moat
- if the AI capex race slows

> *"Då ska man ju snarare äga exempelvis Nvidia, Broadcom, TSMC, de som är lite som hackor och spadar."*

---

### 🟠 TSM — TSMC | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Picks-and-shovels AI supplier; its 2nm process is described as its big moat.

#### Reasoning

Same conditional picks-and-shovels thesis as Broadcom; TSMC also has a manufacturing moat in its 2nm process.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI capex race slows
- if 2nm leadership is lost

> *"Då ska man ju snarare äga exempelvis Nvidia, Broadcom, TSMC, de som är lite som hackor och spadar."*
